| gripper | 72 | 125 | 197 | 110 | +87 |
| **all** | | | **872** | **905** | -33 |

Note: in this design the wrist-roll servo CASE rides in the gripper (its horn is bolted to the wrist bracket), so mass moves from `wrist` to `gripper`; wrist+gripper = 212 g vs spec 185 g. Fasteners, wiring and heat-set inserts are not included (budget +5-10 % per link).

| gripper | [+0.00, +1.60] | [+0.000, +1.600] | [+0.000, +1.600] | yes |

Shoulder: with the shoulder axis only 100 mm above the plate (spec) and the base housing the yaw servo under a 61816 (80 x 100 mm) bearing, the upper arm reaches the base at about +0.63 rad; spec v1.2 sets the limit to +0.60 rad (recorded sim data never goes below -0.64). Elbow: folding down past ~+2.36 rad with the shoulder at zero drives the wrist into the base (a pose-dependent self-collision for the host-side checker, not an adjacent-part clash). Full pairwise clash audit over sweeps and random poses: `python -m cad.audit --random 40` -> cad/out/clash_report.md.
